name: MSX2
description: The 1985 update to the MSX standard, built around Yamaha's V9938 video chip. It added higher resolutions, up to 256 colours and more video memory while staying compatible with MSX1 software. It is the platform where Konami's Metal Gear first appeared.

specs.maker: Several (Sony, Panasonic, Yamaha, Philips and others)

curiosities: Hideo Kojima's Metal Gear debuted on the MSX2 in 1987.
MSX2 machines must include a battery-backed real-time clock.
Konami's SCC sound chip, built into some game cartridges, added five wavetable channels to the system.
Its Yamaha V9938 video chip added 80-column text, resolutions up to 512 × 212 and a 256-colour mode.
